versions.name: Pezza Time
versions.text: Give a monster +1 Dodge. If it was damaged, give it Taunt as well.

versions.name: Pezza Time
versions.text: Deal 4 DMG to a non-DT monster. Delay: If it is damaged and alive, summon a copy of it with its current HP.

versions.name: Pezza Time
versions.text: Add a copy of a damaged ally non-{{RARITY:DETERMINATION}} monster to your hand with its current {{HP}}. It costs 1 less per {{HP}} missing.
